name: Ants: Becker's majority pull
description: Becker's majority pull, which Kirman suggests but does not run: the share of steps with one source holding 80 % or more after 20 000 steps, against the pull, for Figure IIb's strong recruiting and Figure Ic's weak recruiting. Measured (release, seeds 1–5, recorded 2026-09-27): strong 0.79, 0.997, 0.999, 1.000, 1.000 at pull 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2 — the colony locks in at one source; weak 0.001, 0.011, 0.097, 0.53, 0.93 — at pull 1 the exact distribution peaks at 18 % and 82 %, the real ants' 80–20. 'More extreme', as Kirman says.
